body:
SUPERSEDED by §58 (T261, merged 2026-09-01, PR #517): standing derives from the binding, so a federate verb for connectors is unnecessary — S2 (T263) retires the grant ladder for connections.

A default claude.ai connector holds `write` only (SPEC §37: the token exchange mints write standing in the same breath as the actor seed). The loam_federate_* tools (§46, T188) want a `federate` grant naming the container a channel receives into, so a person who connected Claude through OAuth cannot open, adjust, or stage-sever a channel from chat. Today the only paths are the operator bearer or `loam client mint <name> --federate <container>` (§57) — a second key, when the connector already has one. `loam grant <client_id> --verb=register --prefix=<ns>` exists for the register verb; this ticket adds the federate verb beside it. Found while writing docs/first-steps.md for the friends-and-family test, 2026-09-01: the pair section has to send testers to client mint for standing their connector should be able to receive.

This CHANGES WHAT THE SYSTEM PROMISES (a connector may hold federate standing), so it is Myk's merge. Design questions for P1 (Myk): (1) should the grant name exactly one container per invocation (mirroring --prefix), or accept a list; (2) does a federate grant to a connector imply the connector may STAGE a sever (today the tool stages for any federate holder), or should staging stay operator-only; (3) should the OAuth consent page show federate standing when it is granted after the fact.

Acceptance criteria (draft, to be settled at P1):
- (a) `loam grant <client_id> --verb=federate --container <c>` appends a federate grant for the connector's actor naming <c>; loam_whoami for that bearer lists <c> under federateContainers, and loam_federate_connect into <c> succeeds where it refused before. Verify: test/cli/grant-federate.test.ts.
- (b) The grant is two-sided: a channel into a container the grant does not name still refuses; `loam grant revoke` strikes it and the next loam_federate_status answers the ordinary refusal. Verify: the same suite.
- (c) `loam grant list` shows the federate row with its container, live and struck alike. Verify: the same suite.
title: loam grant --verb=federate: hand a connector federate standing without minting a second key
